Observed:
- 20 mm firm mass fixed to the pectoralis major muscle
- Focal asymmetrical density in the retromammary space on mammography
- Lobulated, well-defined mass with heterogeneous internal echoes on ultrasonography
- 59-year-old woman
- Lump in the lower outer quadrant of her left breast
- History of breast-conserving surgery, endocrine therapy, and radiation to the left breast
- Previous carcinoma in the upper inner quadrant of the left breast
- Overlying skin uninvolved
- No palpable axillary lymph nodes
- Mammography showed a focal asymmetrical density in the retromammary space
- Ultrasonography revealed a lobulated, well-defined mass
- Core-needle biopsy suggested atrophic mammary glands
- Lesion increased in size on three-month follow-up
Differential diagnosis:
1. Locoregional breast cancer recurrence
2. Phyllodes tumor
3. Sarcoma of the breast
4. Radiation-induced fibrosis
5. Malignant phyllodes tumor
